description: ETF news for one day from SEC filings: launches, closures, funds filed but not trading, name or ticker changes, fee changes and splits. Defaults to the latest day (is_latest, lag_days); pass date, kind or ticker. Each event is one dated sentence with SEC form, filing date and link; closures and launches first.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest published day.

kind.description: Optional: only this kind of event.

limit.description: Most events to return, 1 to 100. Default 25.

ticker.description: Optional: only events for this fund ticker.

name: etf_news_today

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
